identity: Unique sampled thread whose stack contains anchor_bridge_run_profile
limits: CPU-time samples are statistical, not wall-time fractions. Kernel function names are provided; kernel instruction offsets and exact source lines are not.
Inclusive counts deduplicate a function within each sampled callstack. Different functions are nested and cannot be summed as separate CPU costs.
A sample in spin_unlock_irqrestore does not alone prove lock contention; interrupt restoration and caller context matter.
Bridge-only probes have no model or pad traffic and use ping stimulus; only inference-window captures describe the actual model path.
User-frames are disabled in the combined inference capture. Bridge identity then comes from the owned Android thread snapshot.
